card.name: Pouch and bag packaging nouns
card.fires_on: Nouns naming the packaging itself, mostly "pouch" after foil or open, also bag, seal and tubing. It appears in instructions for opening or handling a package.

modes.label: Opening a pouch
modes.description: The word pouch right after tear open, cut open or foil in opening instructions.

card.plain: It marks the packaging word, such as pouch or bag, in directions for opening or handling the package.
